document_title: SyncFlow Pro v2.0 - Operations & Setup Guide
executive_summary: SyncFlow Pro v2.0 is an automated ETL data orchestration engine designed to sync relational database tables with cloud storage buckets in near real-time. The guide outlines deployment prerequisites, pipeline configuration details using YAML files, and instructions for resolving common operational errors. Support is available through email or the internal developer portal.

On June 02, 2026, the Authentication Service experienced an outage returning HTTP 500 errors for 35% of inbound login attempts due to a connection pool misconfiguration in release v3.4.1. Primary Engineer Sarah Chen rolled back the deployment to stable release v3.4.0 and subsequently deployed patch v3.4.2. System metrics returned to nominal status at 08:50 UTC with a 100% login success rate.

Nexus Enterprise Solutions LLC has entered into a Master Services Agreement with Apex Logistics Ltd. effective March 15, 2026, to provide cloud infrastructure optimization, 24/7 database monitoring, and custom microservice development. Apex Logistics will pay a monthly retainer fee of $18,500 USD under net-30 terms, with a 99.95% operational uptime SLA guarantee. The agreement runs for 12 months, expiring on March 14, 2027, and includes provisions for service credits and 60-day termination notice.
